notes: Read-only tests (TC-01 to TC-08, TC-13, TC-14, TC-19 to TC-29, TC-32, TC-38, TC-39) run automatically.
Mutation tests (TC-09 to TC-12, TC-15 to TC-18, TC-30 to TC-31, TC-33 to TC-37, TC-40, TC-41) require explicit user confirmation.
Set REPOSITORY_ID to run catalog listing tests (TC-03).
Set CATALOG_ID to run catalog-specific tests (TC-04 to TC-06, TC-08, TC-29 to TC-30, TC-38 to TC-39).
Set ASSET_ID to run asset-specific tests (TC-07, TC-10 to TC-11, TC-13 to TC-14, TC-17 to TC-18, TC-21 to TC-24, TC-32 to TC-34, TC-40 to TC-41).
Set VERSION_ID to run version-specific tests (TC-14, TC-21 to TC-24, TC-34 to TC-37).
Set LOCAL_PATH to run import/export tests (TC-30, TC-31, TC-33, TC-34, TC-39 to TC-41).
Set EXPORTED_PATH to run frontmatter-driven import test (TC-38).
Set ALGO_ASSET_ID and ALGO_VERSION_ID to run create-action test (TC-35).
